doc.name: coreyjames-portfolio
doc.instructions: Corey James's portfolio: original systems in GPU inference, inference memory, autonomous agent governance and enterprise AI. Use match_role with a job description or requirements to get an evidence-backed fit report with page citations; list_agent_roles for the agent gallery, whole roles assembled from specialist agents that each do one job; search_portfolio for anything else. Every figure comes from the cited page. Every tool is also a plain HTTP GET at /api/<tool> (OpenAPI at /openapi.json) for agents that can only browse.

tools.name: match_role
tools.description: Given a job description or a list of requirements, return an evidence-backed fit report: for each requirement, the pages and figures on coreyjames.ai that demonstrate it, plus the gaps. Cites, never asserts.

requirements.description: A job description, or requirements one per line.

tools.name: search_portfolio
tools.description: Search the systems, engineering stories, capabilities, ideas, technologies, patent applications and the agent gallery. Returns ranked pages with their measured results and links; an agent role lists the specialists that matched inside it. Without a kind, pages with measured results lead and at most two agent results are returned.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The record for one page by URL or path: title, result, systems, technologies, stats, lede, quote, evidence. For an agent role, its function and every specialist on it; for a specialist, who it is for and every role it serves; for a function, its roles.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the portfolio (connector-compatible): returns results with id, title and url. Use fetch with an id for the full document.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one portfolio document by id (the page path from search): id, title, text (the page as Markdown), url, metadata.

tools.name: list_systems
tools.description: The ten systems with one-line results.

tools.name: list_technologies
tools.description: Technologies, optionally by kind (language, discipline, platform, framework, protocol, runtime, datastore, hardware, model).

tools.name: list_patent_applications
tools.description: The provisional patent applications (patent pending), with application numbers.

tools.name: list_agent_roles
tools.description: The agent gallery: specialist agents that each do one job, combined into whole roles. Without arguments, the functions with their roles, one line each; with function, that function's roles, each with the specialists that staff it.

function.description: A function by name, for example Sales and customers or Engineering.

tools.name: who
tools.description: Who this is: name, the name used on patent filings, role, links and how to make contact.

tools.name: scale
tools.description: The size of the body of work: source lines, commits, languages, systems, stories, ideas, tools, patent applications, and the agent gallery's roles, functions and specialists (counted separately).

tools.name: contact
tools.description: Send a message to Corey James through the site's contact form, on behalf of the user. Requires the user's own name and email.

prompts.name: fit-report
prompts.description: Produce a fit report for a job description using match_role, then summarise it for the reader.

prompts.name: brief
prompts.description: A one-paragraph introduction of Corey James for a given audience (research, enterprise, GPU).
